about.summary: A dashboard example: in an uptrend (above the 200-day average), buy when MACD turns up while Stochastic RSI is not yet overbought; sell when MACD turns down or the uptrend breaks.
about.why: Pairs a trend filter with two momentum oscillators from standard texts: MACD (Appel) and Stochastic RSI (Chande & Kroll). Not a published system; see "MACD Crossover with Trend Filter" for the classic one.
about.caveats: Made for this dashboard as a teaching example and not tested in any publication. Several conditions must line up, so it trades rarely.
references: Appel, G. (2005). Technical Analysis: Power Tools for Active Investors. FT Prentice Hall.
Chande, T. S., & Kroll, S. (1994). The New Technical Trader. Wiley.
